obligations.source_text: Test a human digital twin through an explicit bidirectional live-state relationship between a real adult and her full-scale digital counterpart.

bindings.digital_counterpart_phrase: full-scale translucent digital counterpart with the same appearance and current pose
bindings.outbound_sensor_phrase: wearable biosensors send luminous data paths from her body into the counterpart
bindings.return_update_phrase: a distinct return path carries an updated physiological forecast
bindings.changed_state_phrase: rerouted flood simulation back to her wrist display
